launch_args: Run the Sons Of The Forest dedicated server on the ROAD server machine.
Keep ROAD server targets on 127.0.0.1 if the dedicated server binds 0.0.0.0; change target addresses to the LAN IP if the game server rejects loopback.
On the client machine, if the game refuses 127.0.0.1, keep ROAD client listeners on 0.0.0.0 and connect in-game to that machine's LAN IP.
notes: ROAD carries direct/LAN/local UDP flows only; Steam lobby, Steam relay, and authentication traffic are outside this tunnel.
This profile uses named multi-port UDP targets. Older ROAD clients only use the legacy 8766 target.
Do not add observed ephemeral client or Steam-side ports to the plugin; those are not fixed dedicated-server targets.
Fixed dedicated server UDP listeners observed: 8766, 9700, 27016.
Observed dynamic Steam-related UDP listeners are intentionally not default ROAD targets.
